theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ), ζ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤ → let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => ∏ j ∈ Finset.range w, A (ζ ^ j * t); AnalyticAt ℂ P 0 ∧ analyticOrderAt P 0 ≠ ⊤ ∧ analyticOrderNatAt P 0 = w * analyticOrderNatAt A 0
